attack_quote: This incident was caused by a configuration change to an internal event-routing service that unexpectedly paused delivery of several event streams.

contributing_factors.source_quote: The change depended on feature flags that were not set up as intended
contributing_factors.text: The change depended on feature flags that were not set up as intended.

contributing_factors.source_quote: which the service did not handle gracefully
contributing_factors.text: The routing service did not handle the misconfigured feature flags gracefully.

contributing_factors.source_quote: The code change itself was not reverted by the rollback, so a subsequent deployment reintroduced it.
contributing_factors.text: The rollback reverted the configuration but not the code change, so a later deployment reintroduced it and caused the second period of delays.

fixes.source_quote: The routing service will keep its existing behavior when a feature toggle is missing, so a misconfigured flag can no longer pause delivery.
fixes.text: Keep the routing service's existing behavior when a feature toggle is missing, so a misconfigured flag cannot pause delivery.

fixes.source_quote: We are adding a pre-deploy check that each routing flag exists and is registered under the correct owning service
fixes.text: Add a pre-deploy check that each routing flag exists and is registered under the correct owning service.

fixes.source_quote: we are making flag ownership less error-prone to set.
fixes.text: Make flag ownership less error-prone to set.

fixes.source_quote: We are also improving alerting so we detect paused event delivery sooner.
fixes.text: Improve alerting to detect paused event delivery sooner.

fixes.source_quote: then processed queued events and cleared backlogs.
fixes.text: Rolled back the configuration change, then processed queued events and cleared backlogs.

root_cause.source_quote: This incident was caused by a configuration change to an internal event-routing service that unexpectedly paused delivery of several event streams.
root_cause.text: A configuration change to an internal event-routing service unexpectedly paused delivery of several event streams, which delayed Actions, Pages, Webhooks, Code Scanning, and Copilot coding agent.

timeline.event: Delays began for Actions, Pages, Webhooks, Code Scanning, and Copilot coding agent.
The configuration change was rolled back, mitigating the first period.
timeline.source_quote: We mitigated the first period by rolling back the configuration change at 16:14 UTC.

timeline.event: The first period of delays ended.
Delays began again after a later deployment reintroduced the code change.
timeline.source_quote: and again between 17:20 UTC and 17:55 UTC

timeline.event: A second rollback mitigated the second period.
timeline.source_quote: We mitigated the second period at 17:40 UTC by rolling back again

timeline.event: The second period of delays ended.
timeline.source_quote: and again between 17:20 UTC and 17:55 UTC
